+"""Add business_id, industry, date_onboarded, client_status, first_lead_id, first_inquiry_id to clients.
+
+Revision ID: 0011_client_business_id
+Revises: 0015_named_constraints
+Create Date: 2026-06-22
+
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from alembic import op
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
+from src.backend.models.client import Client
+
+
+revision = "0011_client_business_id"
+down_revision = "0015_named_constraints"
+branch_labels = None
+depends_on = None
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    # Add new columns
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("business_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("industry", sa.VARCHAR(120), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("date_onboarded", sa.DATE(), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("client_status", sa.VARCHAR(32), nullable=False, server_default="Active"))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("first_lead_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("first_inquiry_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+
+    # Create indexes
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients", ["business_id"], unique=True)
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients", ["industry"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients", ["client_status"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients", ["first_lead_id"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients", ["first_inquiry_id"])
+
+    # Backfill existing clients with business_id
+    conn = op.get_bind()
+    # Get all existing clients
+    existing_clients = conn.execute(sa.select(Client.id, Client.created_at).where(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))).fetchall()
+    for client_id, created_at in existing_clients:
+        # Extract year from created_at or use current year
+        year = created_at.year if created_at else 2026
+        # Generate business_id for each client
+        business_id = next_business_id(conn, "CLT", year)
+        conn.execute(
+            sa.update(Client)
+            .where(Client.id == client_id)
+            .values(business_id=business_id)
+        )
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "first_inquiry_id")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "first_lead_id")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "client_status")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "date_onboarded")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "industry")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "business_id")

+import uuid
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user, require_role
+from src.backend.core.roles import Role
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.admin_process import (
+    AdminProcessCreate,
+    AdminProcessListResponse,
+    AdminProcessRead,
+    AdminProcessUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services.admin_process_service import process_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/admin-processes", tags=["admin-processes"])
+
+
+@router.get("", response_model=AdminProcessListResponse)
+def list_processes(
+    _: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+    q: str | None = None,
+) -> AdminProcessListResponse:
+    items, total, page, page_size = process_service.list_processes_service(
+        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, q=q
+    )
+    return AdminProcessListResponse(
+        items=[AdminProcessRead.model_validate(p) for p in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.post("", response_model=AdminProcessRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_process(
+    body: AdminProcessCreate,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+) -> AdminProcessRead:
+    from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
+
+    try:
+        process = process_service.create_process_service(db, body, current_user.id)
+        return AdminProcessRead.model_validate(process)

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Query, UploadFile, status
+from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.drn import DocType, DocumentNature, DRNStatus, IntendedUser
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.drn import (
+    DRNListResponse,
+    DRNRead,
+    DRNUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services import drn_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["drn"])
+
+
+@router.post("/drns", response_model=DRNRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_drn(
+    file: UploadFile | None = File(None),
+    doc_type: str = Form(...),
+    date: str = Form(...),
+    associated_project_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    associated_token_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    author_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    document_nature: str = Form(DocumentNature.INTERNAL.value),
+    intended_user: str = Form(IntendedUser.INTERNAL.value),
+    description: str = Form(...),
+    revision: str = Form("R0"),
+    status: str = Form(DRNStatus.DRAFT.value),
+    remarks: str | None = Form(None),
+    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    if file and file.filename:
+        if len(file.file.read()) > drn_service.MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE, detail="File exceeds 50MB limit")
+        file.file.seek(0)
+
+    try:
+        doc_type_enum = DocType(doc_type)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid doc_type. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocType)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        document_nature_enum = DocumentNature(document_nature)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid document_nature. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocumentNature)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        intended_user_enum = IntendedUser(intended_user)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid intended_user. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in IntendedUser)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        status_enum = DRNStatus(status)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid status. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DRNStatus)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    file_bytes = None
+    original_filename = None
+    if file and file.filename:
+        file_bytes = file.file.read()
+        original_filename = file.filename
+
+    project_id = uuid.UUID(associated_project_id) if associated_project_id else None
+    token_id = uuid.UUID(associated_token_id) if associated_token_id else None
+    author_uuid = uuid.UUID(author_id) if author_id else current_user.id
+
+    drn = drn_service.create_drn(
+        db=db,
+        doc_type=doc_type_enum.value,
+        date=datetime.fromisoformat(date),
+        associated_project_id=project_id,
+        associated_token_id=token_id,
+        author_id=author_uuid,
+        document_nature=document_nature_enum.value,
+        intended_user=intended_user_enum.value,
+        description=description,
+        revision=revision,
+        status=status_enum.value,
+        remarks=remarks,
+        file_bytes=file_bytes,
+        original_filename=original_filename,
+    )
+
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.get("/drns", response_model=DRNListResponse)
+def list_drns(
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+    project_id: str | None = Query(None),
+    token_id: str | None = Query(None),
+    doc_type: str | None = Query(None),
+    status: str | None = Query(None),
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    project_uuid = uuid.UUID(project_id) if project_id else None
+    token_uuid = uuid.UUID(token_id) if token_id else None
+
+    items, total = drn_service.list_drns(
+        db,
+        project_id=project_uuid,
+        token_id=token_uuid,
+        doc_type=doc_type,
+        status=status,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+    return DRNListResponse(
+        items=[DRNRead.model_validate(d) for d in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.get("/drns/{drn_id}", response_model=DRNRead)
+def get_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    drn = drn_service.get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.patch("/drns/{drn_id}", response_model=DRNRead)
+def update_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    update_data: DRNUpdate,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    drn = drn_service.update_drn(db, drn_id, **update_data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True))
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.delete("/drns/{drn_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
+def delete_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    success = drn_service.delete_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not success:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+
+
+@router.post("/drns/{drn_id}/transition-status", response_model=DRNRead)
+def transition_status(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str = Form(...),
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    try:
+        status_enum = DRNStatus(new_status)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid status. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DRNStatus)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    drn = drn_service.transition_status(db, drn_id, status_enum.value)
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.get("/drns/{drn_id}/download")
+def download_file(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    file_path = drn_service.get_file_path(db, drn_id)
+    if not file_path:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found")
+
+    path = Path(file_path)
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found on disk")
+
+    return FileResponse(
+        path=path,
+        media_type="application/octet-stream",
+        filename=f"drn_{drn_id}.file",
+    )

+"""Base CRUD service helper for HR bundle modules.
+
+Provides common CRUD operations for HR-related entities.
+"""
+
+import uuid
+from typing import Any, Generic, TypeVar
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+
+class BaseCRUDService(Generic[T]):
+    """Base CRUD service for HR entities."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repo_module):
+        self.repo = repo_module
+
+    def list_items(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+        q: str | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[list[T], int, int, int]:
+        """List items with pagination and search."""
+        items, total = self.repo.list_items(db, page, page_size, q)
+        return items, total, page, page_size
+
+    def get_item(self, db: Session, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> T | None:
+        """Get item by ID."""
+        return self.repo.get_by_id(db, item_id)
+
+    def create_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        data: Any,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> T:
+        """Create item with audit logging."""
+        item = self.repo.create(db, **kwargs)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.create",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            after_json={
+                "id": str(item.id),
+                **self._get_audit_fields(item),
+            },
+        )
+
+        return item
+
+    def update_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        item_id: uuid.UUID,
+        data: Any,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> T | None:
+        """Update item with audit logging."""
+        item = self.get_item(db, item_id)
+        if not item:
+            return None
+
+        before_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        for key, value in kwargs.items():
+            if hasattr(item, key):
+                setattr(item, key, value)
+
+        self.repo.update(db, item)
+
+        after_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.update",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json=before_json,
+            after_json=after_json,
+        )
+
+        return item
+
+    def delete_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        item_id: uuid.UUID,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Delete item (soft delete) with audit logging."""
+        item = self.get_item(db, item_id)
+        if not item:
+            return False
+
+        before_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        self.repo.soft_delete(db, item)
+
+        after_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.delete",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json=before_json,
+            after_json=after_json,
+        )
+
+        return True
+
+    def _get_entity_type(self) -> str:
+        """Get entity type for audit logging. Override in subclasses."""
+        return "item"
+
+    def _get_audit_fields(self, item: T) -> dict:
+        """Get fields for audit logging. Override in subclasses."""
+        return {"id": str(item.id)}

+"""Local filesystem storage helper for DRN files.
+
+Provides file upload, retrieval, and deletion utilities for DRN documents.
+"""
+
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Save a file for a DRN.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code (e.g., SWA-2025-DBR-001)
+        original_name: Original filename
+        file_bytes: File content as bytes
+
+    Returns:
+        Tuple of (file_path, mime_type)
+    """
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))}")
+
+    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+        raise ValueError("File exceeds 50MB limit")
+
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def get_file_path(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> str | None:
+    """Get the full path for a DRN file.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+        filename: The filename
+
+    Returns:
+        Full file path or None if not found
+    """
+    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
+    return str(path) if path.exists() else None
+
+
+def delete_file(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> bool:
+    """Delete a DRN file.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+        filename: The filename
+
+    Returns:
+        True if file was deleted, False if it didn't exist
+    """
+    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
+    if path.exists():
+        path.unlink()
+        return True
+    return False
+
+
+def list_files(drn_code: str) -> list[str]:
+    """List all files for a DRN.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+
+    Returns:
+        List of filenames
+    """
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    if not d.exists():
+        return []
+
+    return [f.name for f in d.iterdir() if f.is_file()]

+import uuid
+from datetime import date

+
+from src.backend.models.time_log import TimeLog
+
+
+def get_by_id(db: Session, time_log_id: uuid.UUID) -> TimeLog | None:
+    return db.query(TimeLog).filter(TimeLog.id == time_log_id).first()
+
+
+def list_time_logs(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    q: str | None = None,
+    employee_id: str | None = None,
+    work_type: str | None = None,
+    start_date: date | None = None,
+    end_date: date | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[TimeLog], int]:
+    query = db.query(TimeLog)
+
+    if q:
+        search = f"%{q}%"
+        query = query.filter(
+            TimeLog.project_name.ilike(search)
+            | TimeLog.reference_id.ilike(search)
+            | TimeLog.remarks.ilike(search)
+        )
+
+    if employee_id:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.employee_id == employee_id)
+
+    if work_type:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.work_type == work_type)
+
+    if start_date:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date >= start_date)
+
+    if end_date:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date <= end_date)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(TimeLog.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return list(items), total
+
+
+def create(db: Session, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
+    time_log = TimeLog(**data)
+    db.add(time_log)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(time_log)
+    return time_log
+
+
+def update(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
+    for key, value in data.items():
+        setattr(time_log, key, value)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(time_log)
+    return time_log
+
+
+def delete(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog) -> None:
+    db.delete(time_log)
+    db.commit()

@@ -0,0 +1,160 @@
+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
+from src.backend.models.drn import DRN
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return d
+
+
+def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def create_drn(
+    db: Session,
+    doc_type: str,
+    date: datetime,
+    associated_project_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    associated_token_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    author_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    document_nature: str = "Internal",
+    intended_user: str = "Internal",
+    description: str = "",
+    revision: str = "R0",
+    status: str = "Draft",
+    remarks: str | None = None,
+    file_bytes: bytes | None = None,
+    original_filename: str | None = None,
+) -> DRN:
+    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)
+
+    file_path = None
+    if file_bytes and original_filename:
+        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)
+
+    drn = DRN(
+        drn_code=drn_code,
+        doc_type=doc_type,
+        date=date,
+        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
+        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
+        author_id=author_id,
+        document_nature=document_nature,
+        intended_user=intended_user,
+        description=description,
+        revision=revision,
+        status=status,
+        remarks=remarks,
+        file_path=file_path,
+    )
+    db.add(drn)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def list_drns(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
+    status: Optional[str] = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:
+    query = db.query(DRN).filter(not DRN.is_deleted)
+
+    if project_id:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_project_id == project_id)
+    if token_id:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_token_id == token_id)
+    if doc_type:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.doc_type == doc_type)
+    if status:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.status == status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return items, total
+
+
+def get_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[DRN]:
+    return db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.id == drn_id, not DRN.is_deleted).first()
+
+
+def update_drn(
+    db: Session,
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    **kwargs,
+) -> DRN | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+
+    for key, value in kwargs.items():
+        if hasattr(drn, key) and value is not None:
+            setattr(drn, key, value)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def delete_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return False
+
+    drn.is_deleted = True
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_status(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID, new_status: str) -> DRN | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+
+    drn.status = new_status
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def get_file_path(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> str | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+    return drn.file_path

+            TokenStatus.CLOSED,
+            TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.CLOSED: {

+        agreement_id=agreement_id,

+        description=description,
+        token_status=token_status or TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value,
+        tokens_used=tokens_used,
+        swa_team_lead=swa_team_lead,
+        project_owner=project_owner,
+        client_employee_name=client_employee_name,
+        client_employee_email=client_employee_email,
+        notes=notes,
+    )
+
+    db.add(token)
+    db.flush()
+
+    token.token_id = next_business_id(db, "TKN", current_year)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.create",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token.id,
+        user_id=created_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "agreement_id": str(agreement_id),
+            "token_type": token_type,
+            "token_status": token.token_status,
+            "tokens_used": float(tokens_used) if tokens_used else None,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def get_token(db: Session, token_id: uuid.UUID) -> Token | None:
+    return db.query(Token).filter(Token.id == token_id).first()
+
+
+def list_tokens(
+    db: Session,
+    agreement_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    token_status: Optional[str] = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[Token], int]:
+    query = db.query(Token)
+
+    if agreement_id:
+        query = query.filter(Token.agreement_id == agreement_id)
+
+    if token_status:
+        query = query.filter(Token.token_status == token_status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return items, total
+
+
+def update_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    update_data: dict,
+    updated_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token | None:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return None
+
+    old_status = token.token_status
+    for key, value in update_data.items():
+        if hasattr(token, key) and value is not None:
+            setattr(token, key, value)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    if old_status != token.token_status:
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action="token.status_transition",
+            entity_type="token",
+            entity_id=token.id,
+            user_id=updated_by,
+            after_json={
+                "token_id": token.token_id,
+                "from_status": old_status,
+                "to_status": token.token_status,
+            },
+        )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def delete_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    deleted_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> bool:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return False
+
+    token_status = token.token_status
+    if token_status not in {TokenStatus.CANCELLED, TokenStatus.CLOSED}:
+        raise TokenServiceError(
+            f"Cannot delete token with status '{token_status}'. "
+            "Only 'Cancelled' or 'Closed' tokens can be deleted."
+        )
+
+    db.delete(token)
+    db.commit()
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.delete",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token_id,
+        user_id=deleted_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "token_status": token_status,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_token_status(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str,
+    transitioned_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token | None:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return None
+
+    if not can_transition_status(token.token_status, new_status):
+        raise TokenServiceError(
+            f"Invalid status transition from '{token.token_status}' to '{new_status}'"
+        )
+
+    old_status = token.token_status
+    token.token_status = new_status
+
+    if new_status == TokenStatus.CLOSED and token.tokens_used:
+        agreement = (
+            db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+            .filter(ServiceAgreement.id == token.agreement_id)
+            .first()
+        )
+        if agreement:
+            agreement.total_tokens = (
+                (agreement.total_tokens or 0) + float(token.tokens_used)
+            )
+            db.commit()
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.status_transition",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token.id,
+        user_id=transitioned_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "from_status": old_status,
+            "to_status": new_status,
+            "tokens_used": float(token.tokens_used) if token.tokens_used else None,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def get_tokens_by_agreement(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Token]:
+    return db.query(Token).filter(Token.agreement_id == agreement_id).all()

You are Subagent Iota in a 9-agent parallel build of "Wave 9: Operations Digitization" for the SWA ERP at `/Users/srujansai/Desktop/swa-erp`.

## Your task brief (read fully before acting)

# Task 09 (Agent Iota) — Marketing + R&D + Client-Feedback Bundle

## Stream scope
Build 7 modules in one stream:

**Marketing (3 modules):**
1. Instagram Metrics
2. LinkedIn Metrics
3. Website Metrics

**R&D (2 modules):**
4. Research Collaborations
5. Research Innovations

**Client CRM (2 modules):**
6. Client Feedback
7. Client Complaints

## Reference
- Spec: `.specify/specs/wave-9/spec.md`
- Excel sources: `resourses/ERP Sheets/{Instagram,LinkedIn,Website Metrics Sheet}.xlsx`, `Research Collaborations Sheet.xlsx`, `Research Innovations Sheet.xlsx`, `Client Feedback Sheet.xlsx`, `Client Complaints Sheet.xlsx`

## Data models

### `instagram_metric` table (NEW)
| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| id | UUID PK |
| metric_id | String UNIQUE — `SWA-2025-IG-001` via id_gen("IG", year) |
| period_yyyymm | String — "202506" |
| followers_start, followers_end, followers_net_add | Integer |
| impressions, reach, profile_visits | Integer |
| likes, comments, shares, saves | Integer |
| engagement_rate | Numeric(5,4) |
| posts_count, reels_count, stories_count | Integer |
| website_clicks, inbound_dms, leads_count, inquiry_count | Integer |
| notes | Text |
| created_at, updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ |

### `linkedin_metric` table (NEW)
Similar columns adapted from LinkedIn Excel: period_yyyymm, followers_start/end/net_add, impressions, reach, profile_views, reactions, comments, reposts, engagement_rate, posts_count, articles_count, videos_count, website_clicks, inbound_dms, leads_count, inquiry_count, notes.
- metric_id: `SWA-2025-LI-001` via id_gen("LI", year)

### `website_metric` table (NEW)
Period yyyymm +: sessions, users, new_users, returning_users, page_views, pages_per_session, avg_session_duration_sec, bounce_rate, direct_traffic_pct, organic_traffic_pct, social_traffic_pct, referral_traffic_pct, paid_traffic_pct, contact_form_submissions, consultation_requests, downloads_count, call_clicks, leads_count, inquiry_count, projects_converted, notes.
- metric_id: `SWA-2025-WEB-001` via id_gen("WEB", year)

### `research_collaboration` table (NEW)
| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| id | UUID PK |
| collab_id | String UNIQUE — `SWA-2025-COL-001` via id_gen("COL", year) |
| institution_name | String |
| institution_type | Enum(String) — "IIT", "NIT", "IIIT", "Foreign University", "Industry Lab", "Research Org", "Other" |
| department_or_lab | String |
| faculty_or_pi_name | String |
| collab_type | Enum(String) — "Research Collaboration", "Validation/Testing", "Sponsored Research", "Informal", "MoU", "Other" |
| collab_objective | Text |
| domain | Enum(String) — "Acoustic", "Thermal", "Fire", "Energy", "Sustainability", "Material", "Other" |
| start_date, end_date | Date |
| collab_status | Enum(String) — "Proposed", "Active", "Completed", "On Hold", "Terminated" |
| engagement_model | Enum(String) — "MoU", "Informal Collaboration", "Contract", "Grant" |
| linked_innovation_id | String |
| linked_project_id | String |
| primary_internal_owner_id | UUID FK→users.id |
| secondary_internal_owner_id | UUID FK→users.id |
| expected_output | Enum(String) — "Paper", "Report", "Validation", "Prototype", "Patent", "Other" |
| actual_output | String |
| notes | Text |
| created_at, updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ |

### `research_innovation` table (NEW)
| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| id | UUID PK |
| innovation_id | String UNIQUE — `SWA-2025-INN-001` via id_gen("INN", year) |
| innovation_title | String |
| innovation_type | Enum(String) — "Design Innovation", "Process Innovation", "Material Innovation", "Service Innovation", "Other" |
| domain | Enum(String) — same as research_collab domain |
| problem_statement | Text |
| innovation_trigger | Enum(String) — "Internal R&D", "Client Problem", "Site Constraint", "Regulatory", "Market Need", "Other" |
| start_date, concept_freeze_date, validation_complete_date, rollout_date | Date |
| time_to_market_days | Integer |
| innovation_status | Enum(String) — "Idea", "Concept", "In Development", "Validated", "Commercialized", "Killed" |
| commercialization_status | Enum(String) — "Internal Use Only", "Client Deployed", "Monetized", "Not Yet" |
| linked_project_id, linked_client_id | String |
| primary_owner_id, secondary_owner_id | UUID FK→users.id |
| notes | Text |
| created_at, updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ |

### `client_feedback` table (NEW)
| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| id | UUID PK |
| feedback_id | String UNIQUE — `SWA-2025-FB-001` via id_gen("FB", year) |
| date | Date |
| client_id | UUID FK→clients.id |
| reference_type | Enum(String) — "Project", "Agreement", "Token", "DRN", "Other" |
| reference_id | String |
| overall_rating | Integer (1-5) |
| quality_rating | Integer (1-5) |
| timeliness_rating | Integer (1-5) |
| communication_rating | Integer (1-5) |
| would_recommend | Boolean |
| comments | Text |
| created_at, updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ |

### `client_complaint` table (NEW)
| Column | Type |
|---|---|
| id | UUID PK |
| complaint_id | String UNIQUE — `SWA-2025-CMP-001` via id_gen("CMP", year) |
| date_raised | Date |
| client_id | UUID FK→clients.id |
| reference_type | Enum(String) — same as feedback |
| reference_id | String |
| complaint_type | Enum(String) — "Quality", "Timeliness", "Communication", "Billing", "Scope", "Other" |
| severity | Enum(String) — "Low", "Medium", "High", "Critical" |
| description | Text |
| root_cause | Text |
| status | Enum(String) — "Open", "Investigating", "Resolved", "Closed", "Rejected" |
| owner_id | UUID FK→users.id |
| closure_date | Date |
| notes | Text |
| created_at, updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ |

- `src/backend/models/linkedin_metric.py`
- `src/backend/models/website_metric.py`

3: Produces IDs like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`. Uses a DB-backed sequence counter
4: (`IdSequence`) so each (type_code, year) pair advances atomically.
5:

11:

13:

15: 
16: from src.backend.models.id_sequence import IdSequence
17: 
18: 
19: def current_year() -> int:
20:     return datetime.utcnow().year
21: 
22: 
23: def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
24:     """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.
25: 
26:     Args:
27:         db: SQLAlchemy session.
28:         type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
29:             `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
30:             `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
31:             `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
32:         year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
33:             continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).
34: 
35:     Returns:
36:         A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
37:     """
38:     if year is None:
39:         year = current_year()
40: 
41:     seq = (
42:         db.query(IdSequence)
43:         .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
44:         .with_for_update()
45:         .one_or_none()
46:     )
47:     if seq is None:
48:         seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
49:         db.add(seq)
50:         db.flush()
51:

53:     db.flush()
54: 
55:     return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"

"""Business-ID generator.

Produces IDs like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`. Uses a DB-backed sequence counter
(`IdSequence`) so each (type_code, year) pair advances atomically.

Pass `year=0` for "continuous across years" (per meeting: DBR/CAS/GAD numbers
do not reset per year).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.id_sequence import IdSequence


def current_year() -> int:
    return datetime.utcnow().year


def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.

    Args:
        db: SQLAlchemy session.
        type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
            `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
            `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
            `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
        year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
            continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).

    Returns:
        A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
    """
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()

    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()

    seq.last_value += 1
    db.flush()

    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"

import uuid

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Query, UploadFile, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user, require_role
from src.backend.core.roles import Role
from src.backend.db.repositories.boq_repo import (
    count_items,
    get_with_items,
    list_by_project,
    soft_delete,
)
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.models.user import User
from src.backend.schemas.boq import BOQItemListResponse, BOQItemRead, BOQListResponse, BOQRead
from src.backend.services.boq_service import upload_boq

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["boqs"])


@router.post("/projects/{project_id}/boqs", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_boq(
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    file: UploadFile = File(...),  # noqa: B008
    notes: str | None = Form(None),  # noqa: B008
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
):
    if not file.filename:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No file provided")

    content_type = file.content_type or ""
    file_bytes = file.file.read()

    try:
        result = upload_boq(
            db=db,
            project_id=project_id,
            file_bytes=file_bytes,
            file_name=file.filename,
            content_type=content_type,
            parsed_by=current_user.id,
            notes=notes,
        )
        return result
    except ValueError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e)) from e


@router.get("/projects/{project_id}/boqs", response_model=BOQListResponse)
def list_boqs(
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
):
    items, total = list_by_project(db, project_id, page=page, page_size=page_size)
    result = []
    for boq in items:
        d = BOQRead.model_validate(boq)
        d.item_count = count_items(db, boq.id)
        result.append(d)
    return BOQListResponse(items=result, total=total, page=page, page_size=page_size)


@router.get("/boqs/{boq_id}", response_model=BOQRead)
def get_boq(
    boq_id: uuid.UUID,
    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
):
    boq = get_with_items(db, boq_id)
    if not boq:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="BOQ not found")
    d = BOQRead.model_validate(boq)
    d.item_count = len(boq.items) if boq.items else 0
    return d


@router.get("/boqs/{boq_id}/items", response_model=BOQItemListResponse)
def list_boq_items(
    boq_id: uuid.UUID,
    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
    page_size: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200),
):
    from src.backend.models.boq import BOQItem

    query = db.query(BOQItem).filter(BOQItem.boq_id == boq_id).order_by(BOQItem.line_number)
    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
    return BOQItemListResponse(
        items=[BOQItemRead.model_validate(i) for i in items],
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
    )


@router.delete("/boqs/{boq_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
def delete_boq(
    boq_id: uuid.UUID,
    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
):
    success = soft_delete(db, boq_id)
    if not success:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="BOQ not found")

from collections.abc import Callable
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.roles import Role, role_includes
from src.backend.core.security import decode_token
from src.backend.db.repositories.user_repo import get_by_id
from src.backend.db.session import get_db
from src.backend.models.user import User

security_scheme = HTTPBearer()


def get_current_user(
    creds: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security_scheme),  # noqa: B008
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
) -> User:
    try:
        payload = decode_token(creds.credentials)
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or expired token") from e
    if payload.get("type") != "access":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Wrong token type")
    user = get_by_id(db, UUID(payload["sub"]))
    if not user or not user.is_active or user.deleted_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="User not active")
    return user


def require_role(required: Role) -> Callable[[User], User]:
    def _checker(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:  # noqa: B008
        if not role_includes(Role(user.role), required):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Insufficient role")
        return user

    return _checker

import pytest
from httpx import AsyncClient
from sqlalchemy import text

pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio


async def test_admin_can_list_users(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient, admin_user):
    r = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/users")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert "items" in body
    assert any(u["email"] == "admin@swa.co.in" for u in body["items"])


async def test_pm_cannot_list_users(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient):
    r = await authed_pm_client.get("/api/users")
    assert r.status_code == 403


async def test_admin_can_create_user(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "designer@swa.co.in",
            "name": "Designer",
            "password": "design123!",
            "role": "designer",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["email"] == "designer@swa.co.in"
    assert body["role"] == "designer"
    assert "password" not in body
    assert "password_hash" not in body


async def test_create_user_duplicate_email(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient, admin_user):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "admin@swa.co.in",
            "name": "Dup",
            "password": "x1234567!",
            "role": "viewer",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code in (409, 400)


async def test_create_user_short_password(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "short@swa.co.in",
            "name": "Short",
            "password": "abc",
            "role": "viewer",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 422


async def test_pm_cannot_create_user(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient):
    r = await authed_pm_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "x@swa.co.in",
            "name": "X",
            "password": "x1234567!",
            "role": "viewer",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 403


async def test_self_can_read_own(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient, pm_user):
    r = await authed_pm_client.get(f"/api/users/{pm_user.id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200


async def test_pm_cannot_read_other(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient, admin_user):
    r = await authed_pm_client.get(f"/api/users/{admin_user.id}")
    assert r.status_code == 403


async def test_self_can_update_own_name(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient, pm_user):
    r = await authed_pm_client.patch(f"/api/users/{pm_user.id}", json={"name": "PM Renamed"})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["name"] == "PM Renamed"


async def test_self_cannot_update_own_role(authed_pm_client: AsyncClient, pm_user):
    r = await authed_pm_client.patch(f"/api/users/{pm_user.id}", json={"role": "admin"})
    assert r.status_code == 403


async def test_soft_delete(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient, db_session):
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "del@swa.co.in",
            "name": "Del",
            "password": "x1234567!",
            "role": "viewer",
        },
    )
    user_id = r.json()["id"]
    r2 = await authed_admin_client.delete(f"/api/users/{user_id}")
    assert r2.status_code == 204
    r3 = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/users")
    emails = [u["email"] for u in r3.json()["items"]]
    assert "del@swa.co.in" not in emails
    row = db_session.execute(
        text("SELECT deleted_at FROM users WHERE email = :email"), {"email": "del@swa.co.in"}
    ).fetchone()
    assert row is not None
    assert row[0] is not None


async def test_admin_cannot_delete_self(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient, admin_user):
    r = await authed_admin_client.delete(f"/api/users/{admin_user.id}")
    assert r.status_code == 403


async def test_audit_log_on_create(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient, db_session):
    await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/users",
        json={
            "email": "audit@swa.co.in",
            "name": "Audit",
            "password": "x1234567!",
            "role": "viewer",
        },
    )
    rows = db_session.execute(
        text("SELECT after_json FROM audit_log WHERE action = 'user.create'")
    ).fetchall()
    assert len(rows) >= 1
    import json

    after_raw = rows[-1][0]
    after = json.loads(after_raw) if isinstance(after_raw, str) else after_raw
    assert after["email"] == "audit@swa.co.in"


async def test_pagination(authed_admin_client: AsyncClient):
    for i in range(25):
        await authed_admin_client.post(
            "/api/users",
            json={
                "email": f"page{i}@swa.co.in",
                "name": f"P{i}",
                "password": "x1234567!",
                "role": "viewer",
            },
        )
    r = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/users?page=1&page_size=10")
    assert r.json()["page"] == 1
    assert len(r.json()["items"]) == 10
    r2 = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/users?page=3&page_size=10")
    assert r2.json()["page"] == 3

DRN uses type prefix per discipline: `SWA-{YEAR}-{CON|DBR|CAS|GAD|KDR}-{NNN}`.

## 9 work streams (9 parallel subagents)

| # | Agent | Backend | Frontend | Sheets covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Alpha | Inquiry + Service Agreement APIs | InquiriesPage, ServiceAgreementsPage | Inquiries, Service Agreements |
| 2 | Beta | Client business-ID + lead flow patch | ClientsPage rework w/ business-ID | Clients |

- R&D: Research Collab/Innovations — R&D lead write, everyone reads
- Client Feedback/Complaints — anyone can create, only PM+admin can resolve
- Default: viewer role = read-only; PM+admin = write; specialist roles per domain

## Acceptance criteria (runnable)
Each stream's task file lists explicit checks. After all streams merge:
- `pytest tests/wave-9/ -v` → all green
- `pytest tests/ -v` → no regressions (waves 1-6 still pass)

- `cd src/frontend && pnpm tsc --noEmit` → clean
- `cd src/frontend && pnpm build` → clean

- Mobile, multi-tenant, CRM sales-funnel (per PRD non-goals)

"""Wave 9 / Agent Epsilon — Project Tracking module tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio


async def _create_client(authed_admin_client, code: str = "PTC-001", name: str = "PTClient") -> str:
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/clients",
        json={"name": name, "code": code, "primary_email": f"{code.lower()}@example.com"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    return r.json()["id"]


async def test_business_id_auto_generated(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="BIZ-001")
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "BizProj",
            "code": "BP-001",
            "status": "Lead",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    body = r.json()
    year = datetime.utcnow().year
    assert body["business_id"] == f"SWA-{year}-PRJ-001"
    assert body["milestone"] == "Concept"


async def test_business_id_increments(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="INC-001")
    year = datetime.utcnow().year
    ids = []
    for i in range(3):
        r = await authed_admin_client.post(
            "/api/projects",
            json={
                "client_id": client_id,
                "name": f"IncProj{i}",
                "code": f"IN-{i:03d}",
                "status": "Lead",
            },
        )
        assert r.status_code == 201
        ids.append(r.json()["business_id"])
    assert ids == [
        f"SWA-{year}-PRJ-001",
        f"SWA-{year}-PRJ-002",
        f"SWA-{year}-PRJ-003",
    ]


async def test_milestone_filter(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="MF-001")
    await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={"client_id": client_id, "name": "ConceptProj", "code": "MF-A", "milestone": "Concept"},
    )
    await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={"client_id": client_id, "name": "DrawingProj", "code": "MF-B", "milestone": "Drawing"},
    )

    r = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/projects?milestone=Concept")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    items = r.json()["items"]
    assert len(items) >= 1
    assert all(p["milestone"] == "Concept" for p in items)
    codes = {p["code"] for p in items}
    assert "MF-A" in codes
    assert "MF-B" not in codes


async def test_team_leader_filter(authed_admin_client, db_session, admin_user, pm_user):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="TLF-001")

    r1 = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "AdminLed",
            "code": "TLF-A",
            "team_leader_id": str(admin_user.id),
        },
    )
    assert r1.status_code == 201

    r2 = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "PMLed",
            "code": "TLF-B",
            "team_leader_id": str(pm_user.id),
        },
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 201

    r = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/projects?team_leader={admin_user.id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    codes = {p["code"] for p in r.json()["items"]}
    assert "TLF-A" in codes
    assert "TLF-B" not in codes


async def test_progress_indicators_round_trip(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="PI-001")
    indicators = {"design_pct": 30, "calc_pct": 10, "drawing_pct": 0}

    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "PIProj",
            "code": "PI-1",
            "progress_indicators": indicators,
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    pid = r.json()["id"]
    assert r.json()["progress_indicators"] == indicators

    r2 = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/projects/{pid}")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()["progress_indicators"] == indicators


async def test_update_milestone_and_notes(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="UM-001")
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={"client_id": client_id, "name": "UMProj", "code": "UM-1"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    pid = r.json()["id"]

    r2 = await authed_admin_client.patch(
        f"/api/projects/{pid}",
        json={
            "milestone": "Calculation",
            "notes": "In progress",
            "status_updates": "Kickoff done",
        },
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 200, r2.text
    body = r2.json()
    assert body["milestone"] == "Calculation"
    assert body["notes"] == "In progress"
    assert body["status_updates"] == "Kickoff done"


async def test_team_leader_and_owner_attached(authed_admin_client, db_session, admin_user, pm_user):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="TA-001")
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "TAProj",
            "code": "TA-1",
            "team_leader_id": str(admin_user.id),
            "project_owner_id": str(pm_user.id),
        },

    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert body["team_leader_id"] == str(admin_user.id)
    assert body["project_owner_id"] == str(pm_user.id)
    assert body["team_leader_name"] == "Admin"
    assert body["project_owner_name"] == "PM"


async def test_business_id_unique(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="UQ-001")
    r1 = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={"client_id": client_id, "name": "UQ1", "code": "UQ-A", "business_id": "SWA-CUSTOM-001"},
    )
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    r2 = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={"client_id": client_id, "name": "UQ2", "code": "UQ-B", "business_id": "SWA-CUSTOM-001"},
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 409


async def test_milestone_enum_exported(db_session):
    from src.backend.models.project import Milestone

    assert Milestone.CONCEPT.value == "Concept"
    assert Milestone.DBR.value == "DBR"
    assert Milestone.CALCULATION.value == "Calculation"
    assert Milestone.DRAWING.value == "Drawing"
    assert Milestone.VALIDATION.value == "Validation"
    assert Milestone.CLOSEOUT.value == "Closeout"

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from enum import StrEnum

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, Index, String, Text, func
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from src.backend.db.base import Base


class ClientStatus(StrEnum):
    ACTIVE = "Active"
    DORMANT = "Dormant"
    CHURNED = "Churned"


class Client(Base):
    __tablename__ = "clients"
    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    address: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    city: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=True)
    state: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=True)
    pincode: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(20), nullable=True)
    country: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=False, default="India")
    gst_number: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=True)
    primary_email: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(320), nullable=False)
    primary_phone: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=True)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)
    deleted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)

    # Wave 9 — official business-ID + Clients Sheet fields (additive)
    business_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)
    industry: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(120), nullable=True)
    date_onboarded: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    client_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), nullable=False, default=ClientStatus.ACTIVE.value, server_default=ClientStatus.ACTIVE.value)
    first_lead_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)
    first_inquiry_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)

    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_clients_business_id", "business_id", unique=True),
        Index("ix_clients_industry", "industry"),
        Index("ix_clients_client_status", "client_status"),
        Index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "first_lead_id"),
        Index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "first_inquiry_id"),
    )
